group: WTCS technical college districts -- a FORMULA ALLOCATION, not awards
why: All 16 are filed under one source document, 'WI - 2026 - RHTP Advisory Council July 23, 2026'. THAT DECK'S TEXT LAYER CARRIES NONE OF THESE AMOUNTS -- it holds exactly four dollar figures, $203,670,005.21 twice, $300,000, $10 and $1 -- and one slide is image-only, sitting between 'RHT Grant Update' and 'Rurality Designations', which is where such a table would be. The slide after it states the allocation: a $300,000 base plus a 'county funding formula that is used for AEFLA and WTCS Board purposes'. RCJ ALSO STRIPS THE ORGANISATION OUT OF THE NAME: it carries 'Northwood', 'Chippewa Valley', 'Blackhawk' -- bare region names that read as places, not organisations. All 16 map one-to-one onto WTCS's own college roster, archived here, with no extras and no omissions. They are TECHNICAL COLLEGES, so even read as awards they are $0 of hospital money.
